title: Mixed Event — My Color! — Episode6 Unsaid Words

meta.Event Outline: The MORE MORE JUMP! livestream kicks off to a great start! Things are going smoothly, until Shizuku's fear becomes a reality. Shizuku must reevaluate her past and present self in order to arrive at her ultimate decision.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope Shizuku's doing okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She took today off too saying she needed more time to think....

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure she's having a hard time making a decision. We should wait a little longer for her to find her answer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The beautiful idol who can do anything. The one everyone looks up to. That's the Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful*Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The fans who have been supporting me since my time in Cheerful*Days are expecting to see that version of me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Which is why...
I'm not supposed to ruin that image.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm not supposed to be my usual self.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Protecting the image that others expect of her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, sorry...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was just thinking that I sort of understand how Shizuku feels.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I was part of QT, the only job offers I would get were for variety shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The Airi Momoi that appeared on variety shows always wore a confident smile and never missed the opportunity for a clever quip no matter what anyone said to her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After a while, the public started seeing me as nothing more than that girl from those shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Eventually, random people started saying things to me when I was just going about my own business, expecting me to have a good comeback or laugh it off...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't know...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A person's image can be a powerful thing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, in my case, the hardest part was having the agency and my fans expecting me to be Variety Show Airi Momoi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was pretty tough being told nobody wanted to see Airi Momoi the idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I quit being an idol because I didn't like that version of myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I always wondered afterwards whether or not I made the right decision...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By quitting like that, I most likely disappointed the people who liked the girl on those variety shows as well as the girl trying to be an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I keep thinking that I wasn't considerate enough to my fans when I made that decision.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's not easy to live up to others' expectations...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In my case, I was actually pretty good at playing the part they wanted me to. I sort of enjoyed all the stunts and conversations I was a part of...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Shizuku... Her true personality is really different from the idol persona that was created for her, so her problem is a lot more serious.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The Shizuku from Cheerful*Days had a mysterious quality about her, but was so great at singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She felt like someone who was far out of anyone's reach, and it was always so wonderful seeing her like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... I think I like Shizuku as she is now more.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The way she struggles with electronics, how she can be clumsy or forgetful, her drive to always try her absolute hardest...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think all the things about the real Shizuku that we never got to see on TV are wonderful too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If only the fans got to know her better, I'm sure they'd fall in love with her more and more as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Did I say something weird?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, I was just thinking that Shizuku would probably be happy to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, one of the best things about you is the fact you genuinely mean what you say.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's not like you embellish your words either.
You just have a natural talent for cheering others up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's too much praise...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It would be great if more people felt the same way you do, wouldn't it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If only there was a way to show the fans all of her charms! Maybe we could do a livestream to...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, stop right there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While I agree that the idea of doing a stream to help emphasize Shizuku's charms is a good one...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have to wait for Shizuku to find her own answer first.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Her answer...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka's right. Whether she protects her image from when she was with Cheerful*Days or chooses to show everyone who she is now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku is the one who has to make that decision, not us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But... It doesn't feel right to just sit around!
I want to do everything I can to help her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do before she finds her answer?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. What do you say we start preparing what we can for whichever path Shizuku ultimately chooses?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
...
